ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT dated as of the 20th day of December 2016,by and between 162 METROPOLITAN AVENUE LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 100 Prince Street, 4th Floor, New York, New York 10012 (hereinafter referred to as the "Owner" and BROOKLYN BOSS, LLC, a New York limited liability company having an office at 100 Prince Street, 4th Floor, New York, New York 10012 (hereinafter referred to as “Developer"). WITNESSETH WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 162 Metropolitan Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, which premises are also designated on the Tax Map as Block 2365, Lot 7, (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot A" or “Owners” Land", and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” attached hereto and made a part hereof; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof as permitted hereunder, being hereinafter referred to as the “Owners' Building"; and said land and improvements being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Owners'Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of the fee title to a certain parcel of land in the City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 164 Metropolitan Avenue,Brooklyn, New York, which premises are also designated on the Tax Map as Block 2365, Lot 8 (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as “Lot B" or “Developer's Land", and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" attached hereto and made a part hereof; said existing buildings and improvements, together with any alterations thereto built on Developer's Land, being hereinafter referred to as the "Developer's Building"; and said land and improvements together with Developer's New Building, as herein defined, being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Developer's Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer has acquired or will acquire development rights with respect to, or fee simple title to, additional parcels (the “Additional Parcels") such that Owners’ Land, Developer's Land, and the Additional Parcels are contiguous and, pursuant to the Declaration hereinafter referred to, constitute a single “zoning lot” under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building on Developer's Land (herein called the "Developer's New Building"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer's New Building will contain more floor area than now is available for use on Developer's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution 1

(hereinafter defined), and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedures available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for combining Owners’ Land and Developer's Land (and any Additional Parcels) into a single zoning lot for the purpose of making available the Excess Development Rights (hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of Developer's New Building, and Owners are willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Owner is willing to: (a) make the Excess Development Rights available to Developer; and (b) refrain from taking any action that would prevent Developer from: (i) acquiring or using the Excess Development Rights; or (i) constructing the New Building; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in the definition of the term “zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") from Owners’ Land, the Additional Parcels, and Developer's Land. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby agree asfollows: 1. The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions as hereinafter set forth: (a)“Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. (b)“Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located; and (ii) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and that may be authorized to be developed by the New York City Planning Commission or other appropriate agency of the City of New York. (c)“Reserved Development Rights" shall mean the actual Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the existing building located on Owners'Premises as of the date hereof (the “Existing Building"). (d)“Excess Development Rights" shall mean the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Owners’ Land in excess of the Reserved Development Rights and that are being conveyed to Developer pursuant to this Agreement. ascribed tosuchtermsinSection12-10of theZoningResolution. 2
